title: Finance source inventory and baseline
statusReason: The inventory and repository build baseline are complete, but required financial invariants remain unverified: no provider-backed ledger dataset and no Finance-specific unit/integration suite exist. Finance ownership and route parity between the monolith and the extracted service are incomplete.

commit.workingTreeAtStart: Tracked tree clean; user-uploaded roadmap was the only untracked file.

scope: Audit-first/read-only FIN-00-A only. No business logic or route ownership changed; later phases were not executed.

sourceDiscovery.query: rg --files filtered by finance/payment/ledger/accounting/wallet path/name patterns

architectureInventory.databaseModel: The monolith Finance schema uses real-valued amount columns. The existing finance-accounting layer mirrors the kind-based ledger into journal entries; the kind-based ledger remains the documented day-to-day source of truth.
architectureInventory.extractedServiceModel: services/finance uses integer amountCents and its own service-state collections for accounts and transactions; it is a partial boundary, not a replacement for the monolith Finance API.

packageScripts.rootBuild: pnpm run build (runs root typecheck, then recursive builds)
packageScripts.financeService: services/finance has start only; no test/typecheck/build script

architectureInventory.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml installs frozen pnpm lock, runs repository validators and pnpm build; it contains no test command and no Finance-specific invariant test.

proposedFirstExtraction.target: A small Finance domain module inside the existing API server; retain a compatibility re-export from finance-invoice.ts.
proposedFirstExtraction.rationale: These calculation functions are pure and isolated from the database once separated, so they are the smallest existing logic slice to characterize before moving.
requiredProofBeforeExtraction: characterize current rounding at cent and half-cent boundaries
cover quantity, discount and tax behavior
preserve callers and public invoice totals
do not change persistence representation or business behavior
